prompts.prompt: Create a Chinese educational infographic for an existing Wise Invest article, landscape 16:9. It must teach the exact click path, NOT simulate real application screenshots. Elegant white and silver glass accents, restrained champagne gold connectors, dark navy large Chinese sans-serif text, abundant space, crisp high contrast, mobile readable. Top left title: “AI 订阅：从哪里进入？” Small subtitle: “流程示意 · 非官网截图”. Two horizontal lanes each with four numbered stations. Lane 1 heading “ChatGPT”, stations in order “① 登录 chatgpt.com” → “② 头像 / Upgrade Plan” → “③ Get Plus / 获取 Plus” → “④ 填卡并确认付款”. Lane 2 heading “Claude”, stations in order “① 登录 claude.ai” → “② Settings → Billing” → “③ Upgrade plan → Get Pro plan” → “④ 选周期、填卡、Subscribe”. Bottom one restrained note: “付款前：核对套餐、周期、金额与账单地址”. This is an editorial diagram with simple small silver browser and card objects, not an app clone, no fabricated prices or payment success evidence. Every requested Chinese and English label must be exact. Input image is the mandatory original Wise signature. Place it intact at top-right, width about 16% canvas, preserving complete person and all lettering, rounded white plaque corners, 3% safe margins. Do not invent or redraw signature. Leave title away from signature.

Title at top-left: “账单地址：每一项从哪里找？” Subtitle: “字段示意 · 非真实账单 · 不可直接照抄”. Main central area two columns clearly headed “结账页字段” and “填写依据”, seven spacious aligned rows joined by fine arrows. At bottom, clear note inside a very pale gold rounded strip: “从发卡 App / 银行资料核对整组地址；生成器只演示格式”. No realistic card number, address, CVV, personal records or confirmation checkmarks. This is a teaching diagram, not a screenshot. Input image is exact required original Wise signature. Place intact in top-right at 16% canvas width, preserve full person and lettering, rounded corners and 3% margins. Do not redraw or replace signature.
